 Tesla to Halt Production of Electric Pickup Truck 'Cybertruck'
 Kim Jeong-gi 
 Seoul 
 Published 
 2026.11.07 21:12 
 View 
 View Count 
 PIP 닫기 
 Tesla's electric pickup truck, the Cybertruck, launched three years ago, is effectively being discontinued. 
 CEO Elon Musk announced that starting in the middle of next year, the Texas factory will scale back Cybertruck production to manufacture the autonomous taxi, the 'Cybercab'. 
 The Cybertruck, which had initially aimed for annual sales of 500,000 units, saw sales stall at around 20,000 units last year due to its polarizing design, a series of recalls, and a high price tag.
